newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Investors in talks to invest in Recor.
newsitem.headline: Investors in talks to invest in Recor.

text.p: Audio products manufacturer Recor Holdings Ltd said it was in discussion with potential investors about injecting funds into the company.

"The company has discussed with several potential investors, including a financially strong Chinese based group, about injecting funds into the company so as to improve its financial position," Recor chairman James Ho said in a statement.
"The directors anticipate that a preliminary agreement will soon be reached with the potential investors," Hon said.
The statement gave no further details.
The company said it has a very tight cash flow but not to the extent of being unable to pay for raw materials necessary for production.
If there is no improvement in sales or no new funds are injected into the company, the cash flow position will be adversely affected, it said.
Last month, Recor reported a HK$11 million interim loss for the six months to September 30, 1996, and the consolidated net assets of the company was about HK$129 million.
